eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Adams, NE; at 1:29 AM on AUG 11, 2021 Effective until 2:29 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: The Active Shooter scene has been cleared and NO threat to the public remains. Please stay AWAY from the area as the investigation continues. There is no longer a threat to the community and the Shelter In Place has been lifted.  Please continue to stay away from the area as the investigation continues.
